title: The venom never switched on
text: Store the venom's bit at $2D, an address the TIA does not use, instead of ENAM1 ($1E), in the lines B of the throne kernel: the same cycles, the venom flies and wounds in the logic, but nothing draws it. (Taking the store out would also bring every store after it three cycles earlier: the PF2 at the end of the line comes at cycle 59, which the tests forbid.)
